_comment: Free-text identifier fields that existed when the gate was written, and the only ones permitted. ADR 0018 decides that a server-assigned identifier is chosen from a list, never typed; these are the debt that decision was written against, not exceptions to it. Every entry is owned by an E22 task and leaves when that task lands. THE RATCHET: a field not listed here fails the gate, and a listed field that no longer exists ALSO fails it -- so the list cannot be padded and cannot go stale. Shrink it; never add to it. A genuinely permanent exception is an inline `identifier-exception:` annotation naming an ADR 0018 class, not an entry here.
